title: Pullback comparison for the finite partial tensor
statement: For a finite six-functor operation datum S of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], a map f:X→Y, bounded constructible M on Y and finite-Tor bounded constructible L on Y, construct the isomorphism U_f(T_Y(M,L)) ≅ T_X(U_f M,U_f^tor L). Here T is the actual partial tensor and U^tor the restricted pullback of [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates]. Use its fixed-scalar realization: the specified pullback realization at T(M,L), the inverse K-flat/exact pullback comparison, cancellation of the coefficient-equivalence unit inside inverse image, the published fixed-scalar derived tensor/pullback comparison, and tensor of the inverses of fixedPullRealization at M and at the bounded constructible image of L. Lift this explicit ambient isomorphism through the full bounded constructible inclusion. There is no projection map, identity unit, or choice of an existence witness in the construction.

ConstructibleProjectionMates supplies explicit realization and partial tensor constructions, but neither the finite proper transpose in these coordinates nor the normalized tensor-unit equation. FiniteProjectionIdentityNormalization is on fixed-scalar ambient compact-support functors and does not supply these constructible equalities.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Reuse those constructions and generic identities; isolate only the realization normalization and tensor-unit equation.

lean.statement:
def pullbackTensorComparison (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E n hn)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn Y)
    (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn Y.obj.left) :
    (S.finite.pull f).obj (((partialTensor S Y).obj M).obj L) ≅
      ((partialTensor S X).obj ((S.finite.pull f).obj M)).obj ((torPull S f).obj L)
